# References and Provenance

This repository is an original MoonBit implementation. No third-party source
code was copied or translated into the implementation.

Public format references consulted for protocol behavior:

- Intel HEX overview and record layout: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Intel_HEX
- Motorola S-record overview and record layout: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/SREC_(file_format)
- MoonBit language and package documentation: https://docs.moonbitlang.com/

The names Intel HEX and Motorola S-record identify documented data formats and
do not imply endorsement by their respective trademark owners.
